Screenshot full page and verify image data

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import interact, create_engine, PageAction, CrawlConfig, BrowserConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(browser=BrowserConfig(mode="always"))
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    actions = [PageAction(full_page=True, type="screenshot")]
    result = await interact(engine, url, actions)
    print(result.action_results[0].success)
    print(result.action_results[0].action_type)
    print(result.action_results[0].data)

asyncio.run(main())
```
